definition: how far each of the two date nights took my safety down, and how long it stayed

settled:
These figures were read out of my session tracking during the interview and put to me there, so they are a reading of the record rather than something I said.

Both nights were entered from level four.

After the Alan-focused night my safety sat at one for nine hours through Monday morning and was back to four by Tuesday mid-morning, on the order of thirty-nine hours.

After the Jen-focused night it went down to two through Wednesday and was back to four on Wednesday afternoon, on the order of twenty-two hours.

On that reading the hard night costs roughly twice what the other one does, and neither night came near the sub-zero line.
